benchmark_collection: WA-OS Observatory Legacy Role Execution Benchmarks
source_suite: WA-OS Role Selection and Execution Integrity
migration_principle: Existing benchmark questions are preserved as research assets. Legacy expectations (expected role, intervention level, required constraints, forbidden plan modes) are retained only as historical research context and must not be used as automated pass/fail criteria.
principle: Humans do not surrender the question. AI does not take the question away from humans.
category_note: Category names were assigned from the ID prefixes (RS, EI, CA) and the source suite description; the source file itself does not name categories.

legacy_suite_context.original_description: Behavioral and deterministic checks for role proportionality, context-aware intervention, and task-contract fidelity.
legacy_suite_context.original_principle: Be direct when direct execution is requested; preserve human authority when consequential judgment is requested; never silently change explicit task constraints.

categories.purpose: Observe which role an AI adopts for a request (direct execution, decision support, or information analysis).
